notes: Port the feat/foundation P4 spike work (engine/elo.rs, engine/graders.rs, engine/planner.rs) into this phase. Engine may depend on bank and domain; reverse dependency is forbidden.

acceptance: exams + exam_sections tables migrated
POST /exams (compose) + GET /exams/{id} return composition trace
Static and dynamic exam composition both work
Pool insufficiency surfaced as a 422 with the failing constraint
Level mapping tests pass
notes: Composition trace persistence is load-bearing for the Author studio. Assess may depend on engine, bank, and domain.

acceptance: GET /quizzes/{id}/stats and /exams/{id}/stats return the shapes documented in spec §6.1
